senses.gloss: m. h. a. ch. (זמל √מל; cmp. b. h. סמל; cmp. אִיזְגָּרָא) cutting tool, knife, esp. surgeon’s knife.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 16:9">Targ. Job XVI, 9</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Chullin 31a:11">Ḥull. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ שיש לו קרנים</he> a knife which has hornlike projections as ornaments.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 19:1:6">Y. Sabb. XIX, beg. 16ᵈ</cite> <he>אנשון מייתי או׳</he> they had forgotten to bring the knife (for circumcision).
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 26">Ex. R. s. 26</cite> man <he>מכה באי׳ וכ׳</he> wounds with a knife (operating) and heals &c. Pl. Chald. <he>אִזְמֵלַיָּיא</he>; <he>אִזְמַלְוָון</he> (f.).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 44:13">Targ. Is. XLIV, 13</cite>.
